$comment: BuildY policy over the catalog (ADR 0012): the only hand-written catalog data in this repository. pageKindOfBlock names the Page DTO slot shape a Stock block fills (`features` = heading + rows); the block itself (catalogBlock) decides what renders, so several blocks of one kind render side by side. kindRoles gives a kind the informational role page chrome shows in the Blocks feed and the agent item list (ADR 0037: a label, never a placement rule); the generator writes the role of each block into snapshot.json, nothing reads kindRoles at run time. The renderer kinds are derived from pageKindOfBlock. Everything else in catalog/ is generated from the pinned sources. `npm run snapshot` validates every value here against the snapshot (facet values, block ids, Page DTO kinds, roles) and fails on a stale entry.
